def factor_vol_asym_persistence_ewm_span120(df):
    """Asymmetry in volatility clustering persistence between down and up moves, smoothed with slower EWMA span=120."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    pos_ret = ret.clip(lower=0.0)
    neg_ret = ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    pos_persist = (pos_ret**2 * pos_ret.shift(1)**2).ewm(span=120, min_periods=40).mean()
    neg_persist = (neg_ret**2 * neg_ret.shift(1)**2).ewm(span=120, min_periods=40).mean()
    total_persist = pos_persist + neg_persist
    factor = (neg_persist - pos_persist) / total_persist.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_vol_asym_persistence_ewm_span120"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asym_persistence_ewm_span120"]
